analogy.rationale: Insulin secretagogues close KATP channels via SUR1/Kir6.2 (ABCC8/KCNJ11), so ATP channel blockers and sulfonylureas share the same downstream depolarization program; however, these cell lines are not pancreatic beta cells and express little SUR1/Kir6.2, so the transcriptional response should be weak.
